name: zscn-theme-flip-dark-surface
description: ThemeFlip's Dark pane must resolve the dark surface tokens inside a light ambient theme (kata zscn)

mutation.declaration: styles/tokens.css: :root, [data-theme="dark"] { ... } (reverted the selector to :root only, dropping nested-dark-pane scoping from 8b06eb411)
mutation.note: Re-verified against the 2026-11-06 cool-neutral palette. In an isolated frontend copy, baseline passed; removing only the nested dark selector fails all three dark probes: --surface-1 resolves to #FFFFFF instead of #1D2025, pane background to rgb(246, 247, 249) instead of rgb(17, 18, 20), and surface probe to rgb(255, 255, 255) instead of rgb(29, 32, 37). Restoring the selector passes. Light custom-property and painted-surface probes remain unchanged in scope and strength.
